instruction: Enable the 'Pause playback when minimized' option in VLC's interface preferences.

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC Tools > Preferences, navigated to Hotkeys tab, searched for 'play', switched to Advanced Preferences, but repeatedly failed to double-click the correct Global column cell for Play/Pause hotkey. Spent all 50 turns unable to set the global hotkey due to imprecise UI clicking.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Preferences tabs (Interface, Hotkeys, Advanced), use search in hotkey list, type text, switch between Simple and All settings views
metadata.failure_analysis: Model could not precisely target the 'Global' column cell for 'Play/Pause' in the hotkey table. Kept clicking on 'Exit fullscreen' row instead. The hotkey table cells are small and hard to target accurately.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to toggling a checkbox in VLC's Interface Settings. 'Pause playback when minimized' is a visible checkbox that only requires a single click to enable.
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Pause playback when minimized' checkbox in VLC Interface preferences. Custom metric reads vlcrc and checks qt-pause-minimized setting equals 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which is the right source for VLC preference settings.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring vlcrc is flushed to disk with latest settings.
Metric function correctly accesses the rules dict directly via rule.get('expected_qt_pause_minimized', '1'), following the framework convention for type='rule' expected values.
The VLC setting 'Pause playback when minimized' correctly maps to the 'qt-pause-minimized' key in vlcrc, with value '1' meaning enabled.
Single instruction requirement (enable the setting) is fully covered by the single metric check.

Minor concern: substring search 'qt-pause-minimized=' in line could match commented lines (e.g., '#qt-pause-minimized=0') in vlcrc. The loop overwrites with each match, so the last matching line wins. In practice VLC writes active settings after commented defaults, so this is unlikely to cause issues.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider filtering out commented lines (starting with '#') before searching for 'qt-pause-minimized=' to avoid potential false matches from default commented-out values in vlcrc.
